t: This is Wellcome Collection, a museum and library at 183 Euston Road. It shows medical artefacts alongside original artworks, exploring the connections between medicine, life and art. It opened in 2007 and gets over half a million visitors a year. It's named for Sir Henry Wellcome, the American-born pharmaceutical entrepreneur who co-founded Burroughs Wellcome and Company in 1880. He was a keen collector of medical objects. A small selection of them is displayed here, and the rest are managed by the Science Museum. His will also funded the Wellcome Trust, one of the world's largest medical charities.
